name: hazel_weir_central_procedural_graph
description: Grandmaster-optimized Procedural Graph with extended Day 30 Town Shop arbitrage, maturation-gated procurement, low-hurdle 10-hand scaling, active plot-triggered land acquisition, strict 0.85x liquidation floors, and cluster-harvest worker dispatch.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Preemptively matches unlocked town shop demand surges and delivers mature high-margin crops through Day 30 for 2.0x-3.5x contract premiums, with maturation-gated seed procurement.

nodes.name: Shed Headroom Relief
nodes.description: Prevents silent 100/100 harvest discards by clearing uncommitted inventory under strict 0.85x base price floors during critical capacity states (>=90%) while protecting shop contracts and livestock feed.

nodes.name: Oracle Peak Arbitrage & Glut Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to capture cyclical price peaks (>=1.08x base) and dump vulnerable commodities before opponent gluts collapse prices, with terminal sweep on Days 29-30.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash beyond wage reserves into workforce acceleration (10-hand rush), contiguous land expansion up to 28-36 plots, commercial high-yield seeds, and fertilizer.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with strict operational sequencing: cluster-harvest ready crops, batch worker drop-offs, watering, livestock feeding, planting, and ground maintenance.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases (BUY_SEED, BUY_ANIMAL, BUY_LAND, redundant HIRE); schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; route emergency sales through active town shop contracts first where possible before open-market liquidation at hour >= 20 to guarantee payroll.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3 if n_animals > 0 else 0); do not rely on low-margin fertilizer sales to cover payroll deficits; never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (shop_deliverable_inventory > 0 or (net_available_cash >= 100.0 and day <= 27)) and day <= 30
attributes.guidance: Allocate market order slots to fulfill active town shop contracts directly from mature shed inventory to capture 2.0x-3.5x contract price premiums through Day 30 (step 716); procure shop-demanded seeds according to strict crop maturation horizons: halt Pumpkin purchases after Day 23, Tomato purchases after Day 25, and Carrot purchases after Day 27.
attributes.pitfalls: Never halt shop deliveries on Days 29-30 when deliverable inventory exists; do not purchase long-cycle seeds that cannot mature before step 720; never commit seed capital if net cash drops below 1.15x midnight payroll reserve; never deliver Wheat below livestock reserve (n_animals * 3 if n_animals > 0 else 0).

attributes.guidance: Evict pending non-urgent buy orders to free order slots; execute batch sales of unreserved, non-contract surplus holdings strictly maintaining price >= 0.85 * base_price; prioritize selling commodities with lowest forecasted price recovery. Only under critical shed overflow (shed_used >= 96) relax floor to 0.75 * base_price to prevent silent harvest discards. Always reserve produce matching active Town Shop contracts.
attributes.pitfalls: Never fire-sell below 0.85 * base_price during transient clearance spikes; never liquidate Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3 if n_animals > 0 else 0); never sell produce committed to active Town Shop fulfillment.

attributes.condition: (oracle_glut_risk >= 0.30 and current_price >= 0.88 * base_price) or current_price >= 1.08 * base_price or (day >= 29 and shed_used > 0)
attributes.guidance: Execute strategic market liquidations: 1) Peak Arbitrage: Sell unreserved produce whenever market price reaches cyclical peak windows (>= 1.08 * base_price); 2) Glut Defense: Dump vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry, Pumpkin) when oracle signals opponent glut risk >= 0.30, provided price remains >= 0.88 * base_price; 3) Terminal Sweep: Liquidate all remaining unreserved shed inventory on Days 29-30 to maximize final cash score.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell into market troughs below 0.85 * base_price unless on Day 30 terminal liquidation; do not sell commodities committed to active Town Shop orders; do not liquidate Wheat below livestock reserve (n_animals * 3 if n_animals > 0 else 0).

attributes.condition: ((day <= 8 and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.10 + 80.0) or (day > 8 and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.25 + 160.0)) and (hired_hands < 10 or (uncultivated_plots <= 1 and day <= 22) or has_fertilizer_deficit) and day <= 27
attributes.guidance: Aggressively scale workforce to the 10-hand cap by Day 8 using lean early cash reserves; purchase contiguous land plots whenever uncultivated plots drop to <= 1, expanding farm footprint up to 28-36 plots by Day 22; procure high-margin commercial seeds (Pumpkins, Tomatoes, Carrots) and fertilizer to maximize per-plot harvest yield while respecting maturation horizons (no Pumpkin planting after Day 23, no Tomato after Day 25, no Carrot after Day 27).
attributes.pitfalls: Never expand land when uncultivated plots >= 2 or after Day 22; do not hire hands beyond the 10-hand cap; never invest capital if post-transaction balance breaches the midnight wage safety buffer; halt all non-maturing seed purchases after Day 27 to maximize terminal cash accumulation.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch active hands strictly by operational priority: 1) Harvest mature crops within local clusters (continue harvesting adjacent mature plots until backpack holds >= 2 items, backpack is full, or no mature crops remain within 3 tiles); 2) Drop off carried items at shed if carrying >= 2 items, backpack is full, or hour >= 20 for shift close; 3) Water dry planted crops to maintain continuous growth; 4) Feed hungry livestock (if animals > 0); 5) Plant commercial seeds on tilled soil respecting maturation cutoffs; 6) Till soil and clear weeds. On Day 30 after step 705, order all hands to drop off all inventory at shed for final liquidation before step 720.
attributes.pitfalls: Never drop off single harvested items unless no adjacent mature crops exist or hour >= 20; never prioritize weeding or tilling over harvesting or watering; never leave mature crops unharvested across multi-step windows; ensure hands never idle while dry plots or mature crops remain.
